Maya (Partnerships): Heads up — EdgeCore PO EC-4721 keeps getting rejected by marketplace import. Partner says portal flags vendor alias mismatch + missing tax_ein field. Need quick unblock for AP to invoice next week.
invoice-bot: Ingest attempt EC-4721 logged; status=attachment_rejected; errors=[vendor_alias_not_found, missing_field:tax_ein]. ref=ec-4721-142
Devon (Procurement): Can we map their vendor alias temporarily? EdgeCore says their ERP sends vendor_id=EDGE-INT-77 which doesn't match our ledger. If legal/finance ok, procurement can create alias mapping on a one-off basis.
Hannah (Finance): Finance requires tax_ein present for invoicing. If partner cannot reissue immediately, we can accept a signed attestation including tax_ein value and store original. Must capture who authorized alias mapping.
Leo (Legal): Legal: one-off alias mapping is fine if we get partner attestation and record change log. Also require partner to sign an amendment if tax info was redacted previously.
Sam @ EdgeCore: Confirmed: signer is Priya Rao (priya@edgecore.com). Their system currently omits tax_ein in exports for internal testing. We can push an updated file but it won't be live until their nightly deploy (12 hours). Can we do temp mapping + attestation?
Ops Runbook Bot: Suggested temp workflow: 1) create vendor alias mapping `EDGE-INT-77 -> edgecore-main` in staging mapping table 2) upload partner attestation doc to s3://partner-attestations/edgecore/EC-4721/attest.pdf 3) re-run ingest with mapping flag `--allow-temp-alias` 4) tag PO metadata `temp_alias=true; alias_expires=2026-05-03` 5) audit entry required. Example command: `./ingest_po --file ec-4721.xml --map-alias EDGE-INT-77=edgecore-main --audit-note "temp alias per PARTN-462"`
Devon (Procurement): Procurement will create mapping in staging and notify ops to run ingest. We'll require partner attestation posted in thread.
Sam @ EdgeCore: Attestation posted: "I, Priya Rao, confirm tax_ein=12-3456789 for PO EC-4721 and that the enclosed XML is final." (signed). Doc link: https://files.edgecore.com/attest/EC-4721.pdf
Hannah (Finance): Received attestation and link. Finance will accept for this payment cycle provided audit fields recorded: `attestation_url`, `attested_by`, `attestation_ts`.
Leo (Legal): Legal approves one-off alias mapping under conditions: attestation saved, mapping flagged `temp_alias=true`, and partner to follow up with corrected PO in 24 hours. Add clause note to contract folder.
Ops Runbook Bot: Running ingest in staging with `--allow-temp-alias`. Ingest status=processed_staging, checksum pre/post recorded.
invoice-bot: Ingestion event recorded; correlation=ec-4721-tempalias-9f3. Payment hold cleared pending final PO replacement.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — procurement will mark alias for removal after partner pushes fixed PO. I'll update EdgeCore onboarding checklist to call out tax_ein required in exports. Closing this internal thread once procurement confirms final PO received. :white_check_mark:
